text:
olivia: Heads up — seeing ~120 tiny pods stuck Pending in us-west1a since ~03:10. They all request 0.25 GPU (tiny-gang). Scheduler logs show repeated 'lease attach handshake timeout' and the warmpool isn't handing off. Anyone seen this pattern?

sam: saw a handful earlier, thought transient. Is this still spiking or flattened out?

diego: still spiking. pod pending -> NodeLease attach loop in scheduler: `attach attempt 0/5 handshake timeout` repeated.

olivia: exact kubectl snippet: ```
$ kubectl get pods -n ml-prod | grep Pending | wc -l
120
```

nora: can you paste the scheduler line? curious if this is taint/affinity or pure handshake.

olivia: paste from scheduler: ```
E 03:08:21 scheduler.go:attach timed out: lease attach handshake timeout node=gpux-uw1a-07 pod=ml-job-xyz
E 03:09:10 scheduler.go:attach timed out: lease attach handshake timeout node=gpux-uw1a-12 pod=ml-job-abc
```

rebalancer-bot: auto-scan triggered: warm-pool utilization at 92% in us-west1a, available fractional slots fragmented across racks. Suggest defrag run.

sam: warm-pool at 92% + fragmented fractional slots = tough. our handshake path expects fresh lease handshake within 5s; if pool node is busy with NKV cache warming it delays. That could explain timeouts.

mike: Network note — last night we saw NVLink oom-ish errors on gpux-uw1a-07, maybe busy cleaning up sidecars. Could be attach stalls.

nora: two immediate options: 1) force-rebind pending tiny-gang to nodes with >1 free GPU capacity (fast but may impact larger jobs), 2) increase handshake timeout & add jitter to attach retry to avoid thundering herd.

olivia: cost/caution: forced rebind will evict larger jobs or split gangs. We already had a canary eviction spike last week. Prefer minimal customer impact.

sam: short-term patch: bump attach timeout to 15s and add exponential backoff for 3 retries. Also schedule a targeted defrag (rack-aware) for us-west1a.

diego: I'll push a patch to the scheduler config in staging first. small change: `lease.attach.timeoutSeconds=15` and `attach.retryPolicy=exp-backoff(500ms, 3)`.

olivia: can you also add a telemetry flag so we can count how many pods succeed on retry vs immediate? we need to track before/after.

sam: yes — adding `attach.retry.successMetric=attach_retry_success_count` to the rollout.

deploy-bot: rollout started: scheduler-config v2.14.7 -> staging (olivia requested). Monitoring channels: #eng-sre #eng-platform.

mike: for medium-term: recommend a warmpool defrag job that coalesces fractional slots across AZ-local racks, plus a test for tie-breaker that prefers nodes with >0.5 free GPU for tiny-gang. Can we add that to the scheduler roadmap?

nora: agreed; add RFC: `coalesce-fractional-warm-pool` and a preempt guard so large-gang eviction is last resort. I'll draft.

olivia: immediate ask: diego, push the staging config, let it run 30m, then we can promote. Also create an alert for `attach_retry_success_count` > 0 spike so we can verify.

diego: on it. pushing PR, running e2e in staging. ETA 20m.

sam: FYI cost impact note: if we force rebind now we'd likely increase preemptions for 200 large pods -> potential customer impact and extra spot churn. Prefer the timeout/backoff approach.

olivia: thanks. tagging @eng-oncall for awareness. Will follow up with a postmortem if it recurs after the patch. :eyes:
